publication issues.summary: Early unsealed partial V4: 22 unresolved render cells including 19 wire glyph differences and 11 uncertainties, including missing IBM division, six illegible pin identities and three assumed one-character first-destination branches. EXTERNAL_ROW1/EX1 uses a human-authorized no-source anchor; original driver claim is preserved and origin remains unestablished. Individual native differences, routes, points, omissions, independent registration and external schema status remain unestablished. No electrical approval inferred. Team3 source review identifies 12 replacement characters across the top label and reference; no characters are substituted. EX1 targets AG.D10 but its source remains unresolved. Upper PADDL references KF121AA4 and starred AP601BD4 are separate source claims and are preserved separately. Team3 reports native tile 1-3 shows AG D10 extending left beyond the tile with no source label visible there; this is not a full-route proof. All 137 endpoints remain unresolved, 48 contacts unlabeled and six control-only. Block fit untrusted 19/70 and edge 6/38 disagree by up to 1439.467 px, making overlay unreliable. Other 15 tiles, 26 junctions, 239 crossings, full routes, omissions and warp remain unassessed; 25 generated sections were not inspected and eight zero-length segments and 239 unjoined entries are leads only.
